jobs.prompt: Opus security re-review finding for T-0102 (medium), contracts/watch-s4-ops.json: the read API routes (/api/board, /api/project, /api/live, /api/history and every other /api/* read operation) still declare {"boardTokenQuery": []} as an accepted security alternative, so the machine-readable contract still authorizes query-string tokens on JSON APIs. Fix: remove boardTokenQuery from the security list of EVERY /api/* operation so they require boardTokenHeader only. Keep the deprecated boardTokenQuery scheme defined in components (it documents the legacy initial HTML page load, GET / only; if the contract has no GET / path, add one minimal operation for the HTML board page whose security is boardTokenHeader or boardTokenQuery and whose description says the t parameter is only accepted here and is exchanged for an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie under T-8006). Update info.description and the boardTokenQuery description to say that /api/* routes refuse t with 401 once T-8006 lands and that the contract already forbids it. Update tests/watch-s4-contract.test.mjs: no /api/* operation lists boardTokenQuery; owner routes unchanged (header + tailnetSignIn only). Do NOT touch tools/watch-server.mjs, tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Tests: node:test, no network; never write token-shaped literals. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/watch-s4-contract.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. tests/fixtures/ledgers/roadmap-ledger.json only names the contract path as ledger data; it is ignored here and the coordinator runs the full suite.
